title: unified rollouts: canary / A-B / shadow auto-rollback workflow enhancements
author: Ava Chen
body:
Motivation:
Improve safety and observability for automated rollback across canary, A/B and shadow rollout modes. Currently we observe edge cases where metric noise or transient infra blips cause either noisy rollbacks or delayed responses to real regressions. This PR adds: 1) quorum-based metric aggregation to reduce single-metric flapping, 2) a quarantine probing stage that isolates suspicious subsets during rollout, 3) extended telemetry and tracing hooks to attribute rollback decisions, and 4) tuning defaults and backward-compatible flags so existing customers are unaffected unless they opt-in.

Summary of changes (high level):
- rollout/autorollback: add composite metric quorum logic and TTL-based quarantine stage
- rollout/observability: emit rollback_decision.{reason,metric_summary,quorum_count} and add tracing span around decision path
- e2e: new integration tests that exercise noise vs. true-regression scenarios
- docs: rollout config reference and migration notes

Checklist: [x] Design RFC implemented (ENG-7842) [x] Unit + integration tests [x] E2E stability tests (canary + shadow) [x] Backwards-compatible default config [x] Docs and console UI text updates

Rollout plan / Safety notes:
- Default behavior remains the same for existing clusters. New behavior can be enabled via rollout policy v2 flag: "enable_quorum_autorollback".
- When enabled, a rollback decision requires quorum (configurable N-of-M metrics) or explicit high-severity metric breach. The quarantine probing stage will divert a configurable percentage and observe behavior for a configurable TTL before increasing traffic.
- We added a short debounce window (30s) to avoid rolling back on transient spikes observed during autoscaling flaps.

Testing:
- Unit tests for quorum aggregation and TTL timers added.
- Integration harness simulates noisy metric streams, infra flaps, and steady regressions.
- E2E test in perf-canary lab runs a staged shadow then canary with injected latency/regression to validate expected rollback/quarantine flows.

Backwards compatibility and migration:
- New rollout policy defaults to disabled. Migration guide included in docs. Operators can enable per-rollout or cluster-wide.

Related: ENG-7842, ENG-7921.

Notes for reviewers: look closely at the tracing span boundaries and the concurrency around the quarantine timer to ensure we don't leak timers when rollouts are aborted.
commits: Initial implementation of quorum aggregator and tests
Fix race in timer cancellation and add extra unit tests
review_thread: Luis Martinez: Nice end-to-end coverage. Two questions: can we make the quorum config per-tenant and limit max N to avoid config footguns?
Ava Chen: Agreed - quorum is per-rollout and we added validation to enforce N <= number of metrics. Documented in schema comments.
Priya Nair: We need more logs when quarantine expires and we promote traffic (for debugging). Can you add a telemetry event?
Ava Chen: Added rollback_decision.quarantine_promote event and wired it into tracing (see new telemetry_emitter).
Noah Kim: Small nit: the debounce window is hardcoded to 30s in one place and configurable in another. Make consistent.
Ava Chen: Fixed - debounce is now pulled from rollout defaults with a safe minimum enforced in validation.
release_notes: Enhancement: Add quorum-based autorollback and quarantine probing stage for unified rollouts. Adds telemetry for rollback decisions and new e2e tests. Disabled by default; opt-in via rollout policy v2.
notes: This change was validated in the perf-canary lab against synthetic regressions and noise injection. Ops has the migration doc and can toggle the feature per-cluster.
